cohort: Patients with multiple gestations delivered by a single maternal-fetal medicine practice from 2005 to 2016
finding: MFPR in trichorionic triamniotic triplet pregnancies did not significantly improve most obstetrical outcomes compared to ongoing triplet pregnancy, and had worse outcomes compared to dichorionic diamniotic twin gestation.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were lower for the MFPR group compared to the ongoing triplet group.
birth_weight: Mean birth weights were significantly higher for the MFPR group (2,128 g) compared to the ongoing triplet group (1,836 g).
